title: Opening plenary and welcome
abstract: Welcome from the hosts, orientation to the three days, and a look at the state of the DHIS2 community in the Asia-Pacific region.
presenters: HISP Asia · HISP Centre, University of Oslo

title: What's New in DHIS2
abstract: The latest DHIS2 releases, major new platform capabilities, and the roadmap ahead, presented by the core team with time for questions from implementers.
presenters: DHIS2 core team, University of Oslo

title: Country Presentations
abstract: Country teams from across Asia and the Pacific share implementation experiences, achievements, challenges, and practical lessons from their DHIS2 journeys.
presenters: Country delegations · Speakers to be announced

title: Climate
abstract: Climate-informed systems, climate data integration, and regional approaches to using DHIS2 for climate resilience and climate-sensitive programmes.

title: Data Quality
abstract: Practical approaches to data quality review, validation, improvement, and building a culture of trusted data use for decision-making.

title: DHIS2 for Primary Health Care
abstract: Using DHIS2 as an electronic medical record to support integrated, person-centred primary health care, continuity of care, and frontline service delivery.

title: Nutrition + CHW Tracker
abstract: DHIS2 solutions for nutrition programmes and community health worker workflows, including case tracking, referrals, follow-up, and community-level data use.

title: Innovations in Analytics, Performance and AI + DHIS2
abstract: Innovative approaches that combine DHIS2 analytics, performance monitoring, and artificial intelligence to generate insight and support better decisions.

title: Digital Public Goods (DPG)
abstract: Collaboration, governance, and sustainable implementation of open digital public goods, with a focus on how shared solutions can strengthen national digital ecosystems.
presenters: Coordinated by Pamod Amarakoon · Additional speakers to be announced

title: Integration – Digital Blueprint
abstract: Standards-based interoperability, integration architectures, and practical approaches to connecting DHIS2 with other systems through a shared digital blueprint.

title: Education Management Information Systems (EMIS)
abstract: Applying DHIS2 to education data, school management, planning, reporting, and decision-making, with experiences from EMIS implementations.

title: Closing plenary and community discussion
abstract: Reflections on the week, community feedback to shape the future direction of DHIS2 in the region, and a look ahead to 2027.
presenters: HISP Asia · HISP Centre, University of Oslo
